required_top_level.sources: exactly the two source domains below
required_top_level.groups: every physically saved variant, including unadmitted failures with BEFORE-only packets

census.path: exact COMPLETE.attempts for SYNTH or COMPLETE.manifest for REAL

group_record.variant: BEFORE/COVER/SHAM; REAL source ADJACENT_SHAM explicitly maps to SHAM
group_record.admitted_target: -1 if not admitted; visible0 for BEFORE/SHAM, external1 for COVER after separately approved complete pair
group_record.admitted: boolean; all3 variants admitted together only when original source proof is supported
group_record.source_status: byte-equivalent JSON string to original source census status

metadata8_record.row_id: group_id/nativeN (unique occurrence key; never a fake concatenated source ID)
metadata8_record.original_global_index: unchanged source global index; repeats are legitimate
metadata8_record.query_xy: original F64 two values or null
metadata8_record.original_input_flags: original complete flags retained unchanged as provenance

missing_variants: No group or fabricated input. Source full1024+66 census is retained and expanded to3270 variant records with nullable cache_row_indices.
direct_sidecar: TARGETS contains META6 plus int8 direct_end_external_target and string authority. Only selected native can be known; other7 UNKNOWN. No native/quality/owner/broad label promotion.
root_execution: Admission manifest is text created before cache input/SAM/checkpoint bodies. Actual cache and fit each require separate approved root entry and fresh root-entry-supplied output directory under V189 or V190.
